title: PI_RCC — The Simplest Increment: x + sin(x)
description: A cubic-convergent iteration for π whose outer recurrence is not hypergeometric — it falls outside RCC's classified class, yet still attains optimal RC₁ certificate cost. Develops derivative engineering (g(α)=0, g′(α)=−1, g″(α)=0) and the tower of continua from ℚ through algebraic, analytic, elliptic/modular constants and periods.
subtitle: Trilogy II · stress-testing the boundary
pitch: A cubic-convergent iteration for π whose outer recurrence is not hypergeometric — it falls outside RCC's classified class, yet still attains optimal RC₁ cost. Develops derivative engineering and the tower of continua (ℚ → algebraic → analytic → elliptic/modular → periods). Where RCC defines the cost classes, PI_RCC shows their boundary is permeable.
